releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.130:
- MASTER SERVER AUTO-DETECTION: Automatically identifies existing databases (pos.db or legacy database.sqlite) and configures the computer as Master Server (All-in-One) instantly with zero white screens.
- ZERO WIZARDS ON ACTIVE SYSTEMS: Strictly bypasses the station setup wizard on any computer with pre-existing restaurant data, opening directly to the cashier register in under two seconds.
- LEGACY DATABASE AUTO-ADOPTION: Seamlessly imports and preserves legacy database formats without data loss or button layout disruption.
- NETWORK MULTI-STATION STABILITY: Seamless connection across Master Servers, All-in-One registers, and secondary client terminals (Register 2, Kitchen KDS).
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings across all integrity vectors.
